cancellation_and_rescheduling.title: Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy
cancellation_and_rescheduling.free_cancellation_window: Up to 2 hours before scheduled appointment time.
cancellation_and_rescheduling.late_cancellation_fee: Rs. 500 dispatch compensation if cancelled within 2 hours of start time or after worker is en route.
cancellation_and_rescheduling.rescheduling_rules: Rescheduling is 100% free if done before the technician arrives at your location.
cancellation_and_rescheduling.worker_no_show_compensation: If a technician fails to arrive without prior notice, resident receives a Rs. 1,000 platform credit toward their next service.

workmanship_guarantee.title: 7-Day Workmanship Guarantee & Warranty
workmanship_guarantee.warranty_period: 7 days from the completion timestamp of the booking.
workmanship_guarantee.coverage: Covers labor and craftsmanship defects for the specific problem repaired.
workmanship_guarantee.recurrent_issue_resolution: If the exact same issue recurs within 7 days (e.g. pipe leaks again, electrical switch fails), Workio re-dispatches a technician to re-inspect and fix it at zero extra labor charge.
workmanship_guarantee.exclusions: New unrelated faults, user misuse, or pre-existing third-party structural defects are not covered.

pricing_and_payments.title: Pricing & Payment Standards
pricing_and_payments.pricing_models: Hourly rates (typically Rs. 2,000 - 3,500/hr depending on trade) or fixed quotes for major tasks.
pricing_and_payments.advance_payment_rule: Strictly NO advance payment is required for standard service appointments.
pricing_and_payments.payment_timing: Payment is made only upon satisfactory completion and inspection of the work.
accepted_payment_methods: Online debit/credit card through Workio platform
pricing_and_payments.diagnostic_inspection_fee: A standard diagnostic fee of Rs. 1,000 applies only if an in-person diagnostic is performed and the resident chooses not to proceed with the repair.

trust_and_safety.title: Technician Vetting & Safety Standards
vetting_requirements: Mandatory Sri Lanka Police Clearance Certificate
Practical trade skill evaluation & reference check
Ongoing community rating threshold (minimum 4.0 out of 5 stars)
trust_and_safety.property_protection_guarantee: Workio Trust & Safety covers verified accidental property damages caused during the service up to Rs. 50,000.
trust_and_safety.platform_protection_rule: Warranties and damage protections only apply to bookings registered through the Workio platform.

disputes_and_escalation.title: Dispute Resolution & Customer Escalation
disputes_and_escalation.dispute_filing: Residents can report damages, unfulfilled work, no-shows, or overcharging directly in AI Chat or via Support Hotline.
disputes_and_escalation.response_sla: Trust & Safety team reviews formal dispute tickets within 2 to 4 business hours.
disputes_and_escalation.human_supervisor_escalation: For urgent concerns or unresolved issues, chat can be escalated to a live human supervisor with an average wait time under 5 minutes.

support_contacts.operating_hours: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM daily (Sri Lanka Standard Time)
